title: Expose bounded non-causal lexical hints for unresolved V21 qualification failures
goal: After trusted OLQ run #320 remained tags:unknown despite the reviewed prerequisite classifier, add one privacy-safe diagnostic layer that exposes only fixed non-causal lexical hint categories derived in memory from EngineeringException MessageData/DetailMessageData. Preserve the exact qualification transaction and raw-text privacy boundary. Use one later trusted-main qualification run only to decide the next evidence step; hints alone must never be promoted to a causal prerequisite claim.

executionPlan.ordering: Stage 1 protected public-evidence grammar must be independently reviewed, merged, and green on trusted main before Stage 2 begins. The task-authority PR itself implements neither stage.

stages.title: Allow only fixed bounded lexical hints through the trusted public-evidence grammar
stages.author: primary-chatgpt
requirements: Change exactly the two allowed paths and keep the workflow trusted-main-only.

Extend Test-SafeWorkerFailureToken with one optional hints:<comma-separated-fixed-values> token after tags:<...> and before detail-count:<...>. Tokens remain lowercase, deterministically sorted, unique and fixed-allowlisted.

The exact allowed hints are context-support-package, context-software-product, context-license, context-library-element, context-version, context-dependency, semantic-required, semantic-missing, semantic-install, semantic-available, semantic-unsupported, semantic-compatible, semantic-release, semantic-upgrade and semantic-cannot-use.

Existing tags remain causal/classification output and are unchanged. hints are explicitly non-causal observations and must never alter PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED status or be interpreted by the workflow as proof of a prerequisite.
A worker token with no hints remains valid for backward compatibility. tags:unknown hints:<...> is valid only when every hint is exactly allowlisted.
Reject unknown/mixed-case/duplicate/path-bearing/control-character/overlong hint values and reject malformed ordering or a hints token without tags.

Public evidence remains bounded to existing safe identities/tags/counts/fingerprints plus fixed hints. Never publish raw MessageData/DetailMessageData, product names, library object names, paths, usernames or arbitrary Siemens text.
Add deterministic Python/PowerShell regressions for valid hint grammar, backward compatibility, strict rejection and no raw diagnostic publication.
completionGate: Fresh isolated chatgpt-secondary exact-SHA review is APPROVE.
Primary delegated-merges only after both gates pass.
Post-merge CI on trusted main is green before Stage 2.

stages.title: Derive fixed non-causal lexical hints in memory without exposing Siemens text
stages.author: coding-agent
dependsOn: trusted-hints-grammar is independently approved and merged
trusted main contains the fixed hints grammar and green post-merge CI
requirements: Start a fresh coding-agent candidate from then-current trusted main; do not modify the completed TXN-002 implementation except the smallest Program.cs adaptation required to append hints to the existing bounded failure token.
Keep QualificationPrerequisiteClassifier causal tags unchanged. Add a separate Siemens-independent QualificationLexicalHints helper.
Derive hints only from MessageData.Text and DetailMessageData.Text in memory. Never persist or emit the source text.

context-support-package requires support and package/package-family lexical context in the same source string; context-software-product requires software and product in the same source string; context-library-element requires library plus element/type/object in the same source string. context-license, context-version and context-dependency are fixed generic vocabulary signals.

semantic hints are generic predicate-family observations only: required, missing, install/installed/installation, available/unavailable, unsupported/not-supported, compatible/incompatible, release/released, upgrade/migration, and cannot-use equivalents.

Do not expose concrete Siemens/TIA product family names, vendor object names, quoted fragments, numbers, paths, usernames or arbitrary tokens. Output is only the exact fixed hint vocabulary defined by Stage 1.
Hints are sorted/deduplicated deterministically. Empty/no-match input emits no hints token.

Appending hints must preserve the exact existing phase/type/HRESULT, causal tags, detail-count and fingerprints. Migration control flow, qualification transaction, fresh/reuse state, archive/reopen logic and exception propagation remain unchanged.

Add focused synthetic tests with sentinel private paths/users/vendor text proving fixed hints only, same-string context coupling, case-insensitivity, deterministic ordering/deduplication, near-miss rejection and no sentinel leakage.
The helper must be BCL/net48-compatible and linked into SiemensBackend.Tests for net10 execution plus net48 compile evidence without loading Siemens.Engineering on Linux.
completionGate: Primary chatgpt performs independent exact-SHA CODE_REVIEW and returns APPROVE.
No candidate Windows/TIA execution occurs before trusted merge.

scope: Diagnostic evidence only. Do not change RetrieveWithUpgrade -> Save -> Archive -> close -> current-version Retrieve, OpenMode, retry behavior, qualification identity/state/reuse/provenance/publication semantics, AllowList behavior or TIA execution mode.
Do not implement Valve/Stage-B contract discovery/reference generation, dependency resolution, ownership/DB/memory/target facts, generator semantics or any migration workaround.

Hints are not causal tags. A combination of hints may justify a later narrow diagnostic task, but cannot by itself authorize installation changes, licensing assumptions, product/package claims or Stage B.
Raw Siemens reason/detail text remains runner-local and must be removed according to the existing workflow cleanup boundary.
Vendor archives/projects remain outside GitHub. No runner configuration, secret, vendor payload, IndustrialMDE or unrelated workflow change is authorized.
After Stage 2 is independently approved and merged, run exactly one trusted /run-olq-001. If causal tags remain unknown, inspect only the fixed hints and stop; no blind rerun.

tia: After Stage 2 is independently approved, merged and post-merge CI is green, run exactly one trusted OLQ qualification on merged main with the existing trusted source SHA-256 and TIA V21 build identity.
If qualification succeeds, continue only through the already-defined success gates; hints are irrelevant to success.
